description: Family transport rule — mu-Toni follows a host position: the render runs as if in a playing host whose timeline starts at beat 0.125 (mid-sixteenth, 120 BPM). The arp's steps sit on the host's beat grid, so the first note waits for beat 0.25 (62.5 ms) instead of firing at once.

assertions.name: silent_before_the_grid_step
assertions.comment: nothing plays between the host's start (beat 0.125) and the next sixteenth

assertions.name: note_on_the_grid_step
assertions.comment: the first step lands at beat 0.25 (62.5 ms)
